topic: Myth: 'A Facebook page is the same as a website'
caption:
Facebook is not a website.
They can limit your reach overnight. You have zero control.
A website is yours. No algorithm decides if customers find you.
We build sites that work for you around the clock. Link in bio.

copy.myth: My Facebook page is good enough
